title: Delivery timing and pre-delivery service
summary: Feedback on delivery and pre-delivery service is mixed as a topic, with clear praise for smooth delivery in some fragments, complaints about poor service and unreliable collection timing in others, and many mentions that lack enough context for a firm sentiment label.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the delivery experience as very good.

negative.summary: Negative reviews criticize poor pre-delivery service and inaccurate delivery timing that led to inconvenience at the dealership.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention delivery, updates, dates, app visibility, or power delivery, but several are too brief or ambiguous to confirm sentiment and some mix unrelated meanings of delivery.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are labeled undetermined, which limits confidence in identifying a clear overall sentiment pattern.
The cluster mixes vehicle handover and scheduling comments with at least one reference to power delivery, so the topic is not fully coherent.
Some fragments are very short or awkwardly phrased, leaving too little context to interpret sentiment reliably.
